title: rhodanthemum gayanum subsp. fallax
intro: Rhodanthemum gayanum subsp. fallax, commonly known as Chrysanthemum, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. Chrysanthemum has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and providing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and antispasmodic effects, and its ability to modulate the immune system. Furthermore, Chrysanthemum is believed to have anti-aging properties due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory actions, making it a popular ingredient in herbal supplements and traditional remedies.
